# CMD: Off the Record

**CMD: Off the Record** transforms your Custom Music Discs into a fully immersive soundtrack.
Instead of only playing in jukeboxes, your discs now become part of the world—seamlessly playing as ambient background music during gameplay. Explore, build, and survive with a dynamic soundtrack powered by your collection.


> ⚠️ **Reminder:**  
> CMD: Off the Record requires CMD's Resource pack to be installed.  
> 👉 [Download the Resource Pack here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/custom-music-discs-rp)

---

## About

### Immersive & Atmospheric
CMD: Off the Record brings your Custom Music Discs to life beyond the jukebox, turning them into a living, breathing soundtrack. As you explore, your discs echo through the world–creating a unique atmosphere shaped by your journey.

### Thematic
With CMD: Off the Record, your discs don’t stay locked in jukeboxes anymore. They broadcast into your world as a full background soundtrack, turning every moment into a vibe. Whether you're mining, building, or wandering, your music follows you.

### Anniversary / Special Release
CMD: Off the Record is a special anniversary addon that turns your discs into Minecraft’s background soundtrack. Your favourite tracks now play naturally during gameplay, making your world feel more alive than ever.
